description: This file defines two React custom hooks, useAuth and useRequireAuth, for managing authentication state and route protection within a React front-end application. It leverages context, navigation, and routing features from react and react-router-dom.

methods.name: useAuth()
methods.description: A wrapper hook that returns the authentication context, providing access to user info, session data, and auth methods.

methods.name: useRequireAuth()
methods.description: A route-protection hook that redirects unauthenticated users to the /auth page with a redirect parameter, and returns the user if authenticated.
